notes.title: Update Custom Music Mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34198676/3b4aafa2fd42ba0202e758935f250f34443cf7e8.gif[/img]

[b]The Custom Music mode has been updated![/b]

Now you can use the new menu to:

- Play any sound file you have in the windows music folder. (.mp3 or .wav)

- Change settings like sensitivity, volume and the type of audio reaction.

- Let the system listen to audio you have playing in the background (youtube or spotify for example)

notes.title: Update Visionarium 1.2
notes.notes:
So after some valuable feedback I have been working on the following improvements:

- Added Free-fly mode. You can use the right trackpad or joystick to fly 
  around scenes and explore at your own pace. 
- Added Microphone input! Yes you can use your voice or instruments with your 
  primary microphone. The visuals will react to the sounds!
- Added a scene selection menu when you press Escape on keyboard.
- Improved menu ui (fonts and buttons)
- Added pause when you press P on keyboard, so you can stop at anytime 
  when you need some time to recover or admire the artwork
- Added return to main menu gaze button when you press Escape in original 
  experience mode.
- Added Fire Phoenix. You can fly on a phoenix in free fly mode. when you press 
  and hold the X button of the left controller.

Update will be online soon!

notes.title: First Update in Place
notes.notes:
So the first update is up and running!
Here are the things that I changed

- More stable menu buttons
- Better fonts
- Added vive input controler image
- Added Microphone Input Option!
- Added Pause when you press P on keyboard
- Added FPS Counter when you press F

notes.title: Visionarium First Update
notes.notes:
Hello all!

I hope you are having fun experiencing Visionarium. After some valuable feedback I started working on a first update.

Here are some things that im working on:

- Better menu ui and more stable gaze buttons.
- Adding Vive controller button layout screen.
- Programmed particles stay on screen when grabbed.
- Some extra details
- Microphone input, Yes! you can soon use your voice or musical instruments 
   that will react to the visuals.


More info and the update will follow soon!
